sae_vs_asme_decision.decision: SAE J429 sufficient. ASME B18.3.1 not required for v1.
sae_vs_asme_decision.evidence: ASME B18.3(.1) is a dimensional/geometric standard for socket head cap screws, shoulder screws, set screws, and hex keys; not a mechanical-property standard for general bolts/screws/studs. Even socket head cap screw mechanical properties are governed by ASTM A574, not B18.3.1 itself. No scope overlap with SAE J429's general-bolt mechanical-property coverage.
